limits.after_failed_hypothesis: Change hypothesis and continue; not a global goal stop.

evidence_note: U01/U02 closed: row classification (row-classification/1) is separate from the training decision (training-decision/1); only a real `pass` is positive and only a stage that actually ran can be the terminal failure — the review4 counter-examples are held as regression tests. First raster error measured with a read trace: printed `55` read `09`, a printed view label read as `2`, and a lone glyph on no printed number read `4`; the sheet's own readings imply three scales (13.5/51.94/8.43 px/mm), so an unreviewed table is now refused at build while a reviewed one proceeds. Training decision: fix_rules_first, 0 labelable parts, no paid resources. Recall (5 of 8 printed dims have no candidate) and view/datum separation remain open.
